title: Independent audit of manual offline Solana address-mining schedule
objective: Independently audit the manual/offline daily and weekly Solana address-mining scheduler: canonical UTC slots, Monday-only weekly selection, deterministic repeated run identity, sequential invocation, and absence of cron, timers, background workers, database connections, and live network activity.
forbidden_actions: Do not modify source, migrations, or tests.
Do not install or activate cron, timers, background workers, or scheduled triggers.
Do not connect to or deploy PostgreSQL or Redis.
Do not call live Helius, RPC, market-provider, database, Redis, or HTTP APIs.
Do not activate BSC or unpark SOL-E2E-001.
